comparison.objective: Pick up and freely roll a die so a marked face turns from up to down.
comparison.physical_skill: Pickup, ballistic/free release, and settling control.
comparison.success_condition: Marked-face turnover occurs while free and the die rests for 1 s; exact numeric pickup/release tolerances are referenced but absent from the record body.
comparison.reason: The die task tests intentional free-body turnover, not tool-mediated impact at a manufactured notch or recovery of resulting fragments.
